def answer_query(image, query):
    # Initialize the ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Split the query into object and attribute
    object_name, attribute = query.split()

    # Find the patches of the object
    object_patches = image_patch.find(object_name)

    # If the object is not found, return a message
    if not object_patches:
        return f"The object {object_name} was not found in the image."

    # Verify the attribute of the object
    for patch in object_patches:
        if patch.verify_property(object_name, attribute):
            return f"Yes, the {object_name} has {attribute}."

    # If the attribute is not found, return a message
    return f"No, the {object_name} does not have {attribute}."
